rules: Every artifact has one strict v1 input and PASS output accepted by both base-contract verifiers.
The frozen 18-rule library digest is state-before and state-after for every artifact and retention is true.
Exactly one complete A7 mount process-tree receipt is canonicalized, hash-identified, referenced by all 23 bindings, and charged once.
Tool receipts identify only selected frozen rule identities; their direct-use counts sum to the 24 raw selected applications while the separately bound unique-transformation count remains 12.
The exact historical source-build and source-run candidate-generation CPU charge appears in exactly one artifact ledger.

Whole-graph parity and concrete intermediate rewrite checks remain distinct from execution of a rewritten whole graph, atom-cost reduction, universal floating-point soundness, heldout transfer, or fixed-portfolio superiority.

Changed hashes, missing or duplicate artifacts, resource projections, retained state, tools, use counts, unique counts, accounting multipliers, validation access, prospective claims, and unknown fields fail closed.
